Priya R.: hey team :wave: quick heads-up — i need shoulder surgery next week and my doc recommended no heavy typing for ~2 weeks after. worried about on-call and the big refactor i was planning for next sprint.
Jordan M.: thanks for telling us, priya. when is the surgery and what's the expected time off? we can shuffle stuff around.
Priya R.: surgery 2026-04-02, initial recovery 10–14 days, then PT. doc said avoid long keyboard sessions first 2 weeks, can do async reviews and calls though.
Jordan M.: got it. @Taylor (people-ops) can you advise on formal accommodation steps and options (temp on-call exemption, reduced typing, etc)?
Taylor (people-ops): sorry to hear that — we can absolutely do a temporary accommodation. options: short-term on-call exemption, redistribute heavy code tasks, voice-note reviews, or temporary PA/assistant for typing. please fill the intake form so we have documentation: <https://internal.company/hr/accom-form|accommodation intake>. we’ll need a brief note from your provider. everything is confidential.
Priya R.: thanks — i'll submit the form later today. curious re: performance cycle — will this show up negatively?
Taylor (people-ops): short answer: no. using an ADA accommodation is protected and should not be held against you. we'll document temporary adjustments, update goals with your manager, and note the dates. manager expectations will be revised for the period.
Samir K.: happy to cover on-call for the next 3 rotations if that helps. can take the heavy merge windows.
Jordan M.: really appreciate that, samir. plan: shift priya's on-call to samir for rotations starting 2026-04-05 through 2026-05-01, reassign the large refactor to split into smaller PRs, and block priya from last-minute late-night merges. i'll create a tracker issue for the adjustments.
Jordan M.: action: /create-issue #accom-2176543210 — "Priya temporary accommodation: on-call reassignment & task split". tagging @Samir and @Taylor.
people-ops-bot: New accommodation intake received from Priya R. — intake-id 20260401-9842. People Ops will follow up within 48 hours. (automated)
Liz (Legal): quick note from legal: confirm confidentiality and no retaliation. please keep medical docs in HR only. manager may discuss work assignments but not medical details.
Priya R.: appreciate it all — very relieved. i can still do design work, async reviews, and pair on calls with a shared screen so i can minimize typing.
Taylor (people-ops): perfect. we'll set up a 2-week check-in cadence. expect an email with next steps and the accommodation memo (private to you + manager). once form is in, i'll route to HR case file.
Jordan M.: i'll update the sprint board and ping infra to reroute any paging for priya to samir. thanks everyone.
Priya R.: thank you :heart: will submit form in a bit and attach the note.
people-ops-bot: Accommodation form submission confirmed for Priya R. — intake-id 20260401-9842. Next step: People Ops will schedule intake call. (automated)
Jordan M.: follow-up: i've created the tracker and linked tasks. if anything changes priya, please flag here or DM me.
Priya R.: will do. thanks again everyone :slightly_smiling_face:
